name: Easy Bulk Date Editor
author: Andre Moura

sections.description:
Easy Bulk Date Editor lets you update post publish dates in bulk from a single, focused admin screen.

You can:
* Filter posts by category.
* Load up to a few hundred posts at once.
* Edit individual publish dates directly in a table.
* Select posts and shift all their dates by a number of days or hours.

This is especially useful when:
* You are migrating content and need to adjust dates.
* An author’s posts need to be moved forward or backward in time.
* You want to clean up an old content calendar without opening each post one by one.

The plugin works with standard WordPress posts and uses the built-in datetime picker from your browser.

License

This plugin is free for everyone! Since it’s released under the GPL, you can use it free of charge on your personal or commercial site.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder easy-bulk-date-editor to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install it via Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin.
  2. Ensure the main plugin file is named easy-bulk-date-editor.php inside that folder.
  3. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  4. In the admin menu, go to Tools → Easy Bulk Date Editor.
  5. Select a category and click Load posts.
  6. Edit the dates directly in the table or use Shift selected by to move dates in bulk, then click Save changes.
